_comment: Source-of-truth list of client assets, in LOAD ORDER. Hand-maintained.
Adding a client file = add it here. No firmware change is needed: the K10
auto-discovers every file in the SD card's /data root at boot.
app.bundle.js, gzips the bundle + styles + index.html, and writes
assets.json (the manifest the browser loader fetches first). If
assets.json is absent the loader falls back to this file and loads the
scripts one by one — that is also what the mock-server serves in dev.
